name: EasyUploader
description: Easy Uploader is a self-hosted file and photo sharing app. Create named share links protected by passwords. Guests visit the link, enter the password, and upload files or photos directly to your server. Manage all shares and view every upload from the admin panel.

paths.name: Uploads Path
paths.description: Where uploaded files are stored on your server. Map this to the share or folder where you want files to land.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Where the database file is stored. Keep this on persistent storage.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Easy Uploader web interface.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the admin panel. Required.

variables.name: Session Secret
variables.description: A long random string used to sign session cookies. Generate one at: https://generate-secret.vercel.app/64

variables.name: Max File Size (MB)
variables.description: Maximum size per uploaded file, in megabytes.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as. Use 99 for nobody (Unraid default).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as. Use 100 for users (Unraid default).

variables.name: COOKIE_SECURE
variables.description: Set to true only if you are accessing the app over HTTPS via a reverse proxy. Leave false for plain HTTP.

variables.name: TRUST_PROXY
variables.description: Set to true only if running behind a reverse proxy (e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, Swag). Leave false for direct access.
